description: The objects in the user's graph closest in MEANING to one object — nearest neighbours by stored embedding, so it finds related notes, facts, links, files, and posts even when no words match. Use it to browse outward from something search_graph_objects found. Only text-bearing objects carry embeddings (built in the background), so an empty result usually means the source has none yet.

object_id.description: The object to find neighbours of (exact id).

name: similar_objects
title: Find similar objects
